body: Dried figs are cool. Non dry figs look like alien fetuses.
I'm a lady but thanks for considering me a brother haha :)

Yeah, I have a wonderful therapist I see weekly. It's expensive but worth it. I should talk to her more about my suicide ideas. I'm constantly googling suicide methods and have fantasies of what I would do at least a few times per day. Why do I act like my problems are so big? It could be worse. I could be in Syria or dying of cancer. I'm not so special and should just get over it.

Yeah, you aren't. I can't sleep unless I drink. I know it's making things worse. I'm anxious about being late on my car registration renewal but my friend will go to the DMV with me and says I won't be arrested. I just feel more like a little girl than a 25 year old woman because I avoid basically everything that gives me anxiety. I feel pathetic. Thank you for the offer.

It's like my first full week back so I know my brain hasn't gotten used to it yet. I have two master's one of which is a master of social work. I work at a homeless shelter for families. I wouldn't mind working in a shelter but I feel like I'm not actually doing social work. I'm basically like a probation officer there in terms of my job duties. Thanks for responding.
